d: The guests head to Scotland to stay with host Caroline at The Dean B&B a picturesque house with stunning views
The competitors head to Merseysides Kirkby Park where Peter and Sharron host their fellow B and B owners, but poor finishing means the guests feel less than at home.
Extravert Jon attempts to win over his guests with a mixture of shooting and spa-ing, whilst hoping that issues with the shower dont put a dampener on things.
In the small Yorkshire town of Crake, Annette welcomes her fellow B and B owners to Hazelwood Farm. Shes hopeful that she can win over her guests with homemade biscuits and a bicycle ride.
The competition heads to Andy and Julians North Wales retreat of Plas Dinas Country House. An upmarket B and B where rooms cost up to 250, but, its not to everyones taste.
Tears are spilled when the group come face to face to discover who paid who what, before the winner is revealed.
Bill Carstanjen, President & COO of Churchill Downs, goes undercover at his own racetracks.
